text: Entry Requirements 1.1 Citizenship: A citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China. 1.2 Age: 18 – 30 years (Any exception, if any, will be arbitrated case wise). 1.3 Health: No infectious diseases or physical or mental disorders that affect normal study. 1.4 Comprehensive requirements: Well-mannered, friendly to China, and no criminal record. 1.5 Educational requirement: High school graduation is required before enrolling in September 2026. Hold a high school graduation certificate; Hold A certificate of the Unified Examination (UEC) of Chinese independent High schools in Malaysia, or a Malaysian Higher Education Diploma (STPM), or an A-Level diploma, or equivalent qualifications. 1.6 Language Requirement: An applicant for an English-taught program is required to hold a valid English proficiency test certificate, such as IETLS 5.5 or above, TOEFL 75 or above, CEFR B2 or other certificates which can prove his/her English proficiency sufficient to meet the demand of studying and living in China. An applicant who graduates from an English-taught school is exempted from the above certificates. 1.7 CSCA examination subjects: Mathematics, Physics.
